sections.title: Rounding
facts: Nearest ten: look at the ones digit. $0$–$4$ round down, $5$–$9$ round up: $47 \to 50$, $43 \to 40$.
Nearest hundred: look at the tens digit: $650 \to 700$, $649 \to 600$.

sections.title: Twenty-five
facts: Four $25$s make $100$. A quarter of a number: halve it, then halve again.

sections.title: Hundreds and thousands
facts: $\times 100$ moves the digits two places left: $37 \times 100 = 3700$.
Bonds to $1000$: the hundreds make $9$ and the tens make $10$: $370 + 630 = 1000$.
